scope: Independent review/verification/optimization round 1 of the delivered M2 work.

audit.liveRuntime: agent connected, lifecycle running, exactly one channel

findingsFixed.finding: environment.open renew path did not require a ready current observation; during an agent outage it could create a ready binding/session and only fail at provider connect, leaving an orphan binding version (observed historically as v2 orphans).
findingsFixed.fix: Ready gate now applies to renew and normal opens before the link/binding transaction; renewal during not-ready fails environment-not-ready with no binding or link rows. Offline regression asserts exactly one binding row and no link row.

findingsFixed.finding: environment.resolve did not guard against malformed or non-object result_json before spreading it into the resolution payload.
findingsFixed.fix: Safe parse with object fallback; resolution remains the only payload on malformed input.

findingsFixed.finding: t202.connect.bindings.mjs carried unused workspace/observation variables after filtering was added.
findingsFixed.fix: Removed dead variables; syntax and connect flow retested.

findingsFixed.finding: Delivery verification was manual and not reproducible from the repo.
findingsFixed.fix: Added scripts/dev/verify_delivery.mjs (offline manifest/checksum/invariant audit plus --runtime channel/agent check); baseline run passed 6/6.

residual: Existing duplicate D02 workspace names keep the old shared label; only newly materialized workspaces get the binding suffix.
unknown operation rows total 25 (13 historical + 9 outage + 3 T-205 attempt) and remain visible/unresolved by design.
Remote Git/watch UI, native desktop, T-206 real CLI, real create, cross-Host/M3 remain out of scope.
